notes.title: Update Notice 0821
notes.notes: [h1]Update Notice 0821[/h1][p] [/p][p]PS controller support is now available.[/p][p]New status effects have been added, and updates have been implemented based on these.[/p][p]Attacking monsters with a torch will now set them on fire.[/p][p]Fixed the damage caused by burning in certain situations.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/df545336f50dde687cff8c1e23dcc68765cff52b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/56f41823c81c0f443c2c97bcb5f2795c0101010e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Language[/h3][p]A pop-up for quick language selection is now provided when entering the game for the first time. (You can still change the language version at any time via the settings options.)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p]1. Updated the descriptions of some items to more clearly show their effects.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where the Defense stat was displaying incorrectly.[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue related to Respawn Points.[/p][p]4. To address the issue of small animals getting lost, we have equipped them with a collective GPS tracking system. They will no longer wander off easily.[/p][p]5. The Guardians have given the island's monsters an ideological education; they will no longer sleep in the mines.[/p][p]6. The Seed Merchant has imported healthier seeds. Our fruits and vegetables now provide higher Satiety and Hydration.[/p]

notes.title: [August 18 Update Notice]
notes.notes:
[h1][b]\[August 18 Update Notice][/b][/h1][h3][b]Thank you for your support and understanding. This update includes:[/b][/h3][p] [/p][h3]1. Gamepad controller support (Button mapping not yet visible in settings - remapping coming later)[/h3][p]Y = Menu[/p][p]A = Confirm/Attack[/p][p]B = Back/Cancel/Switch building forms (only for structures with multiple forms, e.g. wall)[/p][p]Press and hold B = Open buildable forms menu (only for structures with multiple forms, e.g. wall)[/p][p]X = Interact/Item Info[/p][p]D-pad/Stick = Walk (Hold R2 to run)[/p][p]L1 = Select left quickslot / Switch[/p][p]R1 = Select right quickslot / Switch[/p][p]L2 = Dodge Roll[/p][p]R2 = Sprint[/p][p] [/p][h3]2. Bug Fixes[/h3][p](1) Fixed abnormal running behavior with gamepads[/p][p](2) Fixed text display errors[/p][p](3) Other miscellaneous bugs[/p][p] [/p][h3]3.New[/h3][p](1) Lava Burn Status: Upon entering the lava in a volcanic map, you will enter a Burn status, continuously losing HP.[/p][p] [/p][p]Note: Prolonged alt-tabbing may cause abnormalities. Restart the game if this occurs. This is an engine limitation we're actively resolving. Thank you for your patience.[/p][p]
[/p]
